name: Prime Module
description: A compact reserve core stores spare charge and helps nearby systems recover after heavy use.

name: Harm Accelerator
description: A focused output coil boosts a defender’s strike strength for a brief burst of pressure.

name: EMI Module
description: A pulse emitter disrupts incoming ranged targeting and gives nearby defenses time to respond.

name: Repair Module
description: Automated repair arms restore a small amount of a defender’s integrity at regular intervals.

name: Strange Refractor
description: A layered prism bends incoming force away and strengthens a defender’s guard.

name: Superconductor-1000
description: A chilled coil stores energy for a more powerful first special attack.

name: Superconductor-2000
description: A high-capacity coil stores energy for a more powerful second special attack.

name: Paralyzer
description: A short-range pulse interrupts movement and briefly slows a target’s response.

name: Laser Guidance
description: A calibrated sight improves the speed and consistency of ranged attacks.

name: Nightbird's Mark
description: A precision beacon highlights weak points and improves the chance of a critical strike.

name: Brawler's Fury
description: This close-combat unit raises combo damage and adds force when its defender is weakened.

name: Demolitions Cache
description: A reinforced charge adds a blast effect to a defender’s heavy attack.

name: Exo-Filter
description: A compact shielding array reduces the effects of unstable incoming energy.

name: Transwarp Cell
description: A spatial regulator pairs with heavy attacks to disrupt an opponent’s stored energy.

name: Robot Resource
description: Two tuned crystal cores provide a steady increase to a base defender’s power output.

name: Scout's Sentry
description: A fast-response sensor boosts first-strike readiness and helps a defender react sooner.

name: Security Protocol
description: An automated safeguard reinforces a defender’s armor while its systems are under pressure.

name: Tactician's Trick
description: A timing relay disrupts an opponent’s rhythm and makes special attacks less predictable.

name: Tech Console
description: A compact control interface helps an operator coordinate precise, high-impact actions.

name: Warrior's Call
description: A rally signal briefly hardens a defender and increases its offensive momentum.

name: Generic Offence
description: A straightforward power unit increases a defender’s basic strike output.

name: Generic Defense
description: A durable support unit improves a defender’s health and resistance.

name: Generic Utility
description: A flexible support unit improves recovery and adaptability during a fight.

name: Attack Module
description: A reinforced drive channel delivers additional force through standard attacks.

name: Health Module
description: A reinforced life-support field helps a defender withstand more damage.
